mechanics.title: Torch-disabled spawners
mechanics.description: A spawner with 5 torches around it is disabled and spawns nothing. All torch types are supported.

vanilla_changes.change: Disabled while surrounded by 5 torches of any type.

getting_started: Place 5 torches around a spawner to switch it off.
editor_notes: Exact torch placement (which 5 positions) not specified by the source; verify in-game if documenting precisely.
name: Better Spawner Control
summary: Mob spawners stop spawning when surrounded by 5 torches. All torch types count. Lets you shut down monster spawners (blaze spawners in particular) without breaking them.
